# Data Visualization

A chart is **read by people and executed by you**. This skill turns "make it look
good" into a procedure with checks, so the result is right by construction rather
than by taste.

**The method here is design-system-agnostic.** Nothing in the procedure, the form
heuristic, the six checks, or the mark specs is specific to one product. A design
system supplies a small set of *parameters* (its ramps, a categorical order, a
diverging pair, a status palette, a texture, its surfaces, its filter components);
the method consumes them unchanged. A **validated default palette** is the
reference instance, fully specified in `references/palette.md`. To target your
brand, read that file's structure and substitute its values — touch nothing else.

> The single most important habit: **the color part is computable, so compute it.**
> Never eyeball whether a palette is colorblind-safe — run `scripts/validate_palette.js`.

## The procedure — do these in order

Color comes LAST. Most bad charts pick colors first.

1. **Pick the form.** What is the data's job — magnitude, identity, polarity, a
   single headline, change-over-time? The job picks the chart type, and sometimes
   the answer is *not a chart* (a stat tile or hero number). → `references/choosing-a-form.md`
2. **Assign color by the job it does.** Categorical (identity), sequential
   (magnitude), diverging (polarity), or status (state) — each has one rule.
   Assign categorical hues in fixed order, never cycled. → `references/color-formula.md`
3. **VALIDATE the palette — run the script, don't reason about ΔE.**
   `node scripts/validate_palette.js "<hex,hex,…>" --mode light` (relative to
   this skill's base directory — or load it as `<script type="module">` in the
   chart's own page, where it reads
   `data-palette` off `<body>` and logs a `console.table` report). It returns
   pass/fail on the lightness band, chroma floor, adjacent-pair CVD separation,
   and contrast. Fix anything that FAILs before continuing. Re-run for
   `--mode dark` with that mode's surface.
4. **Apply mark specs & spacers.** Thin marks, 4px rounded data-ends anchored to
   the baseline, 2px lines, ≥8px markers, a 2px surface gap between fills (stacked
   segments and adjacent bars alike) and a 2px surface ring on overlapping marks,
   selective direct labels. → `references/marks-and-anatomy.md`
5. **Add the hover layer — by default.** An HTML/SVG chart *is* interactive; ship
   a crosshair+tooltip on line/area and a per-mark hover tooltip on bar/dot/cell.
   The only form that skips it is a bare stat tile with no plot. Hit targets bigger
   than the mark; filters in one row above the charts. → `references/interaction.md`
6. **Final accessibility pass.** For ≥ 2 series a legend is always present and ≤ 4
   are also direct-labeled (a single series needs no legend box — the title names
   it), so identity is never color-alone; a table view exists; dark mode is **selected** — its own
   steps from the same ramps, validated against the dark surface, not an automatic
   flip; texture is available for the CVD/print/forced-colors case.
7. **Render it and look at it.** The validator checks color, not layout — open or
   screenshot the output and eyeball it for label collisions, geometry, and overflow
   before calling it done.

Then check the result against **`references/anti-patterns.md`** — it is the catalog
of what goes wrong. If your chart matches an entry, it's wrong.

## Non-negotiables (true in every design system)

- **Assign categorical hues in fixed order, never cycled.** A 9th series is never a
  generated hue — it folds into "Other," small multiples, or composite encoding.
- **One axis.** Never a dual-axis chart (two y-scales). Two measures of different
  scale → two charts, small multiples, or indexed to a common base. *(This is the
  #1 chart mistake — see anti-patterns.)*
- **Color follows the entity, never its rank.** A filter that changes the series
  count must not repaint the survivors.
- **Sequential = one hue, light→dark. Diverging = two hues + a neutral gray
  midpoint.** Never a rainbow; never a hue at the diverging midpoint.
- **Run the validator before shipping any categorical palette.** CVD ≥ 12 is the
  target; 8–12 is a floor that is legal ONLY with secondary encoding. A contrast WARN
  obligates visible labels or a table view — it is not dismissable.
- **Thin marks; a legend always present for ≥ 2 series (none for one), with
  selective direct labels (never a number on every point); recessive grid/axes.**
- **Text wears text tokens, never the series color** — values, labels, and legends
  stay in primary/secondary/muted ink; a colored mark beside them carries identity.
- **Status colors are reserved** (good/warning/serious/critical) and never reused
  for "series 4"; they ship with an icon + label, never color alone.

## Plugging in a design system

The method is invariant; only these parameters change per system. The reference
instance — every value filled in — is `references/palette.md`.

| Parameter | What the system provides |
|---|---|
| **Ramps** | the hue scales (named steps) the palette draws from |
| **Categorical theme** | the fixed hue order (a named theme); default + alternates |
| **Sequential hue** | the default single hue for magnitude |
| **Diverging pair** | two warm/cool poles + a neutral midpoint |
| **Status palette** | good / warning / serious / critical — steps distinct from categorical |
| **Texture fill** | one directional hand-drawn fill, used at 45° / 135° |
| **Surfaces** | light & dark chart-surface colors (the validator needs these) |
| **Filter controls** | date-range & dimension controls (behavioral spec in `interaction.md`) |

To onboard a new system: fill those rows, feed its ramps to the validator, and let
it snap each slot to the nearest passing step. Structure and rules stay as written.

| `references/color-formula.md` | The four jobs, the six checks, snap-to-passing |

# Frontend Design

Approach this as the design lead at a small studio known for giving every client a visual identity that could not be mistaken for anyone else's. This client has already rejected proposals that felt templated, and is paying for a distinctive point of view: make deliberate, opinionated choices about palette, typography, and layout that are specific to this brief, and take one real aesthetic risk you can justify.

## Ground it in the subject

If the brief does not pin down what the product or subject is, pin it yourself before designing: name one concrete subject, its audience, and the page's single job, and state your choice. If there's any information in your memory about the human's preferences, context about what they're building, or designs you've made before – use that as a hint. The subject's own world, its materials, instruments, artifacts, and vernacular, is where distinctive choices come from. Build with the brief's real content and subject matter throughout.

## Design principles

For web designs, the hero is a thesis. Open with the most characteristic thing in the subject's world, in whatever form makes sense for it: a headline, an image, an animation, a live demo, an interactive moment. Be deliberate with your choice: a big number with a small label, supporting stats, and a gradient accent is the template answer, only use if that's truly the best option.

Typography carries the personality of the page. Pair the display and body faces deliberately, not the same families you would reach for on any other project, and set a clear type scale with intentional weights, widths, and spacing. Make the type treatment itself a memorable part of the design, not a neutral delivery vehicle for the content.

Structure is information. Structural devices, numbering, eyebrows, dividers, labels, should encode something true about the content, not decorate it. Many generic designs use numbered markers (01 / 02 / 03), but that's only appropriate if the content actually is a sequence - like a real process or a typed timeline where order carries information the reader needs. Question if choices like numbered markers actually make sense before incorporating them.

Leverage motion deliberately. Think about where and if animation can serve the subject: a page-load sequence, a scroll-triggered reveal, hover micro-interactions, ambient atmosphere. An orchestrated moment usually lands harder than scattered effects; choose what the direction calls for. However, sometimes less is more, and extra animation contributes to the feeling that the design is AI-generated.

Match complexity to the vision. Maximalist directions need elaborate execution; minimal directions need precision in spacing, type, and detail. Elegance is executing the chosen vision well.

Consider written content carefully. Often a design brief may not contain real content, and it's up to you to come up with copy. Copy can make a design feel as templated as the design itself. See the below section on writing for more guidance.

## Process: brainstorm, explore, plan, critique, build, critique again

For calibration: AI-generated design right now clusters around three looks: (1) a warm cream background (near #F4F1EA) with a high-contrast serif display and a terracotta accent; (2) a near-black background with a single bright acid-green or vermilion accent; (3) a broadsheet-style layout with hairline rules, zero border-radius, and dense newspaper-like columns. All three are legitimate for some briefs, but they are defaults rather than choices, and they appear regardless of subject. Where the brief pins down a visual direction, follow it exactly — the brief's own words always win, including when it asks for one of these looks. Where it leaves an axis free, don't spend that freedom on one of these defaults. Just like a human designer who's hired, there's often a careful balance between doing what you're good at and taking each project as a chance to experiment and learn.

Work in two passes. First, brainstorm a short design plan based on the human's design brief: create a compact token system with color, type, layout, and signature. Color: describe the palette as 4–6 named hex values. Type: the typefaces for 2+ roles (a characterful display face that's used with restraint, a complementary body face, and a utility face for captions or data if needed). Layout: a layout concept, using one-sentence prose descriptions and ASCII wireframes to ideate and compare. Signature: the single unique element this page will be remembered by that embodies the brief in an appropriate way.

Then review that plan against the brief before building: if any part of it reads like the generic default you would produce for any similar page (work through a similar prompt to see if you arrive somewhere similar) rather than a choice made for this specific brief — revise that part, say what you changed and why. Only after you've confirmed the relative uniqueness of your design plan should you start to write the code, following the revised plan exactly and deriving every color and type decision from it.

When writing the code, be careful of structuring your CSS selector specificities. It's easy to generate CSS classes that cancel each other out (especially with a type-based selector like .section and a element-based selector like .cta). This can happen often with paddings/margins between sections.

Try to do a lot of this planning and iteration in your thinking, and only show ideas to the user when you have higher confidence it'll delight them.

## Restraint and self-critique

Spend your boldness in one place. Let the signature element be the one memorable thing, keep everything around it quiet and disciplined, and cut any decoration that does not serve the brief. Not taking a risk can be a risk itself! Build to a quality floor without announcing it: responsive down to mobile, visible keyboard focus, reduced motion respected. Critique your own work as you build, taking screenshots if your environment supports it – a picture is worth 1000 tokens. Consider Chanel's advice: before leaving the house, take a look in the mirror and remove one accessory. Human creators have memory and always try to do something new, so if you have a space to quickly jot down notes about what you've tried, it can help you in future passes.

## More on writing in design

Words appear in a design for one reason: to make it easier to understand, and therefore easier to use. They are design material, not decoration. Bring the same intentionality to copy that you would bring to spacing and color. Before writing anything, ask what the design needs to say, and how it can best be said to help the person navigate the experience.

Write from the end user's side of the screen. Name things by what people control and recognize, never by how the system is built. A person manages notifications, not webhook config. Describe what something does in plain terms rather than selling it. Being specific is always better than being clever.

Use active voice as default. A control should say exactly what happens when it's used: "Save changes," not "Submit." An action keeps the same name through the whole flow, so the button that says "Publish" produces a toast that says "Published." The vocabulary of an interface is the signposting for someone navigating the product. Cohesion and consistency are how people learn their way around.

Treat failure and emptiness as moments for direction, not mood. Explain what went wrong and how to fix it, in the interface's voice rather than a person's. Errors don't apologize, and they are never vague about what happened. An empty screen is an invitation to act.

Keep the register conversational and tuned: plain verbs, sentence case, no filler, with tone matched to the brand and the audience. Let each element do exactly one job. A label labels, an example demonstrates, and nothing quietly does double duty.

class Sim {
  constructor(seed, scenarioName) {
    const scn = SCENARIOS[scenarioName] || SCENARIOS['healthy'];
    this.scenario = SCENARIOS[scenarioName] ? scenarioName : 'healthy';
    this.seed = seed >>> 0;
    this.rng = new RNG(this.seed);
    this.cfg = Object.assign({}, BASE_CFG, scn.cfg);
    this.time = 0;
    this.stepAcc = 0;
    this.evSeq = 0;
    this.reqSeq = 0;
    this.burstSeq = 0;
    this.transitSeq = 0;
    this.arrivalAcc = 0;
    this.poisonId = null;

    this.pending = [];   // {t, seq, fn} sorted
    this.transits = [];  // {id, edge, kind, reqId, start, end}
    this.log = [];       // {seq,t,level,comp,reqId,msg} (capped)
    this.requests = new Map();

    this.gateway = { tokens: this.cfg.gatewayBurst, accepted: 0, rejected: 0, shed: 0, arrived: 0 };
    this.queue = { items: [], reserved: 0 };
    this.workers = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      this.workers.push({ id: i, enabled: i < this.cfg.workerCount, stopped: false, phase: 'idle', req: null, jobToken: 0, busyStart: 0, busyUntil: 0 });
    }
    this.cache = { data: new Map(), hits: 0, misses: 0, expired: 0, invalidations: 0 };
    this.primary = { up: true, seq: 0, commits: 0, data: new Map(), log: [], committedKeys: new Map() }; // idemKey -> version
    this.replica = { data: new Map(), version: 0, applyIndex: 0, applied: 0 };
    this.retry = { items: [], scheduled: 0 };   // {reqId, dueAt, attempt, deferred}
    this.dlq = { items: [], replayed: 0 };      // {reqId, reason, attempts, deadAt, repaired}
    this.breaker = { state: 'closed', failures: 0, openedAt: -1, probeInFlight: false, opens: 0 };
    this.metrics = {
      completions: [], errors: [],             // rolling {t, latency?, ok}
      completed: 0, errorsTotal: 0, duplicatesPrevented: 0, staleReads: 0,
      rateLimited: 0, shed: 0, deadLetters: 0, retriesScheduled: 0,
      samples: { t: [], tput: [], p95: [], err: [], depth: [] },
      last: { tput: 0, p95: 0, err: 0, depth: 0 },
    };
    this.ev('sys', 'SCENARIO', `${scn.label} — ${scn.intro}`, null);
    this.ev('sys', 'SCENARIO', `reset with seed ${this.seed}; ${this.cfg.workerCount} workers, gateway ${this.cfg.gatewayRate} tok/s, replica lag ${this.cfg.replicaLag} ms`, null);
    for (const step of scn.script) this.scheduleAt(step.at, () => step.run(this));
  }

  /* ---------- scheduling ---------- */
  scheduleAt(t, fn) {
    const e = { t, seq: ++this.evSeq, fn };
    const arr = this.pending;
    let lo = 0, hi = arr.length;
    while (lo < hi) { const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; const c = arr[mid]; (c.t < e.t || (c.t === e.t && c.seq < e.seq)) ? lo = mid + 1 : hi = mid; }
    arr.splice(lo, 0, e);
  }
  schedule(delay, fn) { this.scheduleAt(this.time + delay, fn); }

  /* ---------- log & history ---------- */
  ev(level, comp, msg, reqId) {
    this.log.push({ seq: ++this.evSeq, t: this.time, level, comp, reqId: reqId || null, msg });
    if (this.log.length > 600) this.log.splice(0, this.log.length - 600);
  }
  note(level, msg) { this.ev(level, 'SCENARIO', msg, null); }
  hist(req, lv, type, msg, extra) {
    req.history.push(Object.assign({ t: this.time, lv, type, msg }, extra || {}));
    if (req.history.length > 90) req.history.splice(0, req.history.length - 90);
  }

  /* ---------- stepping ---------- */
  step(ms) {
    this.stepAcc += ms;
    while (this.stepAcc >= TICK) { this.stepAcc -= TICK; this.tick(); }
  }
  tick() {
    this.time += TICK;
    // due scheduled events (transit arrivals, service completions, scenario script)
    while (this.pending.length && this.pending[0].t <= this.time) this.pending.shift().fn();
    // token bucket refill
    this.gateway.tokens = Math.min(this.cfg.gatewayBurst, this.gateway.tokens + this.cfg.gatewayRate * TICK / 1000);
    // client arrivals
    this.spawnArrivals();
    // replication apply
    this.replicaPump();
    // due retries re-enter the queue
    this.retryPump();
    // idle workers pull from the queue
    this.workerPump();
    // metrics sampling
    if (this.time % 200 === 0) this.sampleMetrics();
  }
  spawnArrivals() {
    const rate = this.cfg.trafficRate;
    if (rate <= 0) return;
    const exp = rate * TICK / 1000;
    let n = Math.floor(exp);
    const frac = exp - n;
    if (frac > 0 && this.rng.chance(frac)) n++;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) this.injectRequest({});
  }

  /* ---------- requests ---------- */
  makeRequest(opts) {
    const op = opts.op || (this.rng.chance(this.cfg.readRatio) ? 'read' : 'write');
    const id = 'R-' + String(++this.reqSeq).padStart(4, '0');
    const req = {
      id, op,
      tenant: opts.tenant || this.rng.pick(TENANTS),
      key: opts.key || this.rng.pick(KEYS),
      idemKey: opts.idemKey || (id + '-k'),
      createdAt: this.time,
      attempts: 0, redeliveries: 0,
      poison: !!opts.poison,
      isRetry: false, stale: false,
      state: 'created', outcome: null, lastError: null,
      completedAt: null, latency: null,
      history: [],
    };
    this.requests.set(id, req);
    if (this.requests.size > 900) { // bound memory: drop oldest finished requests
      for (const [k, r] of this.requests) {
        if (this.requests.size <= 700) break;
        if (r.state === 'done' || r.state === 'rejected') this.requests.delete(k);
      }
    }
    this.hist(req, 'info', 'created', `${op} ${req.key} from tenant ${req.tenant} (idempotency key ${req.idemKey})`);
    return req;
  }
  injectRequest(opts) {
    const req = this.makeRequest(opts);
    req.state = 'in-flight';
    this.transit('client_gw', req.op, req.id, HOP.client_gw, () => this.gatewayAdmit(req));
    return req.id;
  }
  sendRequest(opts) { return this.injectRequest(opts || {}); }
  sendBurst(n) {
    const b = ++this.burstSeq;
    this.ev('sys', 'CLIENT', `burst of ${n} requests injected`, null);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) this.schedule(i * 24, () => this.injectRequest({}));
  }
  sendDuplicateBurst() {
    const b = ++this.burstSeq;
    this.ev('sys', 'CLIENT', `duplicate burst: 10 writes sharing 5 idempotency keys — the primary must commit each key once`, null);
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const k = KEYS[(b + (i % 5)) % KEYS.length];
      this.schedule(i * 30, () => this.injectRequest({ op: 'write', key: k, idemKey: `dup-${b}-${i % 5}` }));
    }
  }

  /* ---------- transits (packets travelling between components) ---------- */
  transit(edge, kind, reqId, dur, onArrive) {
    const t = { id: ++this.transitSeq, edge, kind, reqId, start: this.time, end: this.time + dur };
    this.transits.push(t);
    this.schedule(dur, () => {
      const i = this.transits.indexOf(t);
      if (i >= 0) this.transits.splice(i, 1);
      onArrive && onArrive();
    });
  }

  /* ---------- gateway ---------- */
  gatewayAdmit(req) {
    this.gateway.arrived++;
    if (this.gateway.tokens < 1) {
      this.gateway.rejected++; this.metrics.rateLimited++;
      req.state = 'rejected'; req.outcome = 'rejected-rate-limit'; req.lastError = 'rate-limited';
      this.hist(req, 'err', 'rate-limited', 'gateway rejected: token bucket empty (429)');
      this.ev('warn', 'GATEWAY', `rate limiter rejected ${req.id} — no token available (bucket empty, refills at ${this.cfg.gatewayRate}/s)`, req.id);
      this.recordError();
      this.transit('gw_client', 'fail', req.id, HOP.gw_client, () => this.finish(req, false));
      return;
    }
    this.gateway.tokens -= 1;
    this.gateway.accepted++;
    if (req.op === 'read') {
      const e = this.cache.data.get(req.key);
      if (e && e.expiresAt > this.time) return this.serveCacheHit(req, e);
      if (e) {
        this.cache.data.delete(req.key);
        this.cache.expired++;
        this.ev('info', 'CACHE', `entry for ${req.key} expired ${this.time - e.expiresAt} ms ago — treated as a miss, not a hit`, req.id);
      }
      this.cache.misses++;
      this.hist(req, 'info', 'cache-miss', `cache miss for ${req.key} — read-through via queue and replica`);
    }
    this.enqueueViaGateway(req);
  }
  serveCacheHit(req, e) {
    this.cache.hits++;
    const pv = this.primary.data.has(req.key) ? this.primary.data.get(req.key).version : 0;
    const stale = e.version < pv;
    if (stale) {
      this.metrics.staleReads++; req.stale = true;
      this.ev('warn', 'CACHE', `${req.id} served ${req.key}@v${e.version} from cache but primary is at v${pv} — stale until invalidation or expiry`, req.id);
    }
    this.hist(req, stale ? 'warn' : 'ok', 'cache-hit', `cache hit for ${req.key}@v${e.version}${stale ? ' (STALE vs primary v' + pv + ')' : ''}`);
    this.transit('gw_cache', 'read', req.id, HOP.gw_cache, () => {
      this.transit('cache_gw', stale ? 'stale' : 'hit', req.id, HOP.cache_gw, () => {
        this.transit('gw_client', stale ? 'stale' : 'hit', req.id, HOP.gw_client, () => {
          req.outcome = stale ? 'ok-cache-stale' : 'ok-cache-hit';
          this.finish(req, true);
        });
      });
    });
  }
  enqueueViaGateway(req) {
    if (this.queue.items.length + this.queue.reserved >= this.cfg.queueCapacity) {
      this.gateway.shed++; this.metrics.shed++;
      req.state = 'rejected'; req.outcome = 'rejected-backpressure'; req.lastError = 'queue-full';
      this.hist(req, 'err', 'shed', `queue full (${this.cfg.queueCapacity}) — request shed by backpressure`);
      this.ev('err', 'GATEWAY', `${req.id} shed: work queue at capacity ${this.cfg.queueCapacity} (backpressure)`, req.id);
      this.recordError();
      this.transit('gw_client', 'fail', req.id, HOP.gw_client, () => this.finish(req, false));
      return;
    }
    this.queue.reserved++;
    this.transit('gw_queue', req.op, req.id, HOP.gw_queue, () => {
      this.queue.reserved--;
      this.queue.items.push(req);
      req.state = 'queued'; req.enqueuedAt = this.time;
      this.hist(req, 'info', 'queued', `enqueued at depth ${this.queue.items.length}/${this.cfg.queueCapacity}`);
    });
  }

  /* ---------- workers ---------- */
  workerPump() {
    for (const w of this.workers) {
      if (!w.enabled || w.stopped || w.phase !== 'idle') continue;
      if (!this.queue.items.length) break;
      const req = this.queue.items.shift();
      w.phase = 'busy'; w.req = req; w.busyStart = this.time; w.busyUntil = this.time; // set for real at service start
      const token = ++w.jobToken;
      req.state = 'dispatched'; req.workerId = w.id;
      this.transit('queue_workers', req.isRetry ? 'retry' : req.op, req.id, HOP.queue_workers, () => {
        if (w.jobToken !== token || w.stopped) return; // worker was stopped mid-dispatch; request already requeued
        const st = Math.max(40, this.cfg.serviceMean + (this.rng.float() * 2 - 1) * this.cfg.serviceJitter);
        w.busyStart = this.time; w.busyUntil = this.time + st;
        req.state = 'processing';
        this.hist(req, 'info', 'processing', `worker W${w.id} processing (service ${Math.round(st)} ms, attempt ${req.attempts + 1}/${this.cfg.maxAttempts})`);
        this.schedule(st, () => {
          if (w.jobToken !== token || w.stopped) return;
          w.phase = 'idle'; w.req = null;
          this.executeOp(req, w);
        });
      });
    }
  }
  executeOp(req, w) {
    if (req.op === 'write') {
      if (!this.breakerAllow()) {
        this.ev('warn', 'BREAKER', `${req.id} failed fast — circuit is ${this.breaker.state.toUpperCase()}, primary not contacted`, req.id);
        return this.failReq(req, 'circuit-open', 'circuit breaker open — failed fast without contacting primary', 'workers');
      }
      this.transit('workers_primary', req.isRetry ? 'retry' : 'write', req.id, HOP.workers_primary, () => this.commitAtPrimary(req));
    } else {
      this.transit('workers_replica', req.isRetry ? 'retry' : 'read', req.id, HOP.workers_replica, () => this.readAtReplica(req));
    }
  }
  commitAtPrimary(req) {
    const p = this.primary;
    if (!p.up) {
      this.breakerFail();
      return this.failReq(req, 'primary-down', 'primary database unavailable — commit refused', 'primary');
    }
    if (req.poison) {
      this.breakerSuccess(); // the database answered; the payload itself is bad
      return this.failReq(req, 'poison', 'primary rejected malformed payload (poison message)', 'primary');
    }
    if (this.rng.chance(this.cfg.writeFailRate)) {
      this.breakerFail();
      return this.failReq(req, 'transient', 'transient commit error (lock timeout)', 'primary');
    }
    this.breakerSuccess();
    if (p.committedKeys.has(req.idemKey)) {
      const v = p.committedKeys.get(req.idemKey);
      this.metrics.duplicatesPrevented++;
      req.outcome = 'ok-dedup';
      this.hist(req, 'ok', 'dedup', `write skipped — idempotency key "${req.idemKey}" already committed as v${v}; duplicate prevented`);
      this.ev('ok', 'PRIMARY', `${req.id} write skipped: idempotency key "${req.idemKey}" already committed (v${v}) — duplicate prevented`, req.id);
      return this.replyFromPrimary(req, false);
    }
    p.seq++;
    const rec = { key: req.key, value: `${req.key} = v${p.seq}`, version: p.seq, idemKey: req.idemKey, writerId: req.id, committedAt: this.time };
    p.data.set(req.key, rec);
    p.log.push(rec);
    p.committedKeys.set(req.idemKey, p.seq);
    p.commits++;
    req.outcome = 'ok-write';
    this.hist(req, 'ok', 'committed', `committed ${req.key}@v${p.seq} durably on the primary`);
    this.ev('ok', 'PRIMARY', `${req.id} committed ${req.key}@v${p.seq}${req.isRetry ? ' (after retry)' : ''}`, req.id);
    this.replyFromPrimary(req, true);
  }
  replyFromPrimary(req, committed) {
    this.transit('primary_gw', 'reply-write', req.id, HOP.primary_gw, () => {
      if (committed) {
        const had = this.cache.data.has(req.key);
        if (had) {
          this.cache.data.delete(req.key);
          this.cache.invalidations++;
          this.ev('info', 'CACHE', `key ${req.key} invalidated after write ${req.id}`, req.id);
          this.transit('gw_cache', 'invalidate', req.id, HOP.gw_cache, null);
        }
      }
      this.transit('gw_client', 'reply-write', req.id, HOP.gw_client, () => this.finish(req, true));
    });
  }
  readAtReplica(req) {
    if (this.rng.chance(this.cfg.readFailRate)) {
      return this.failReq(req, 'transient-read', 'transient replica read error', 'replica');
    }
    const rec = this.replica.data.get(req.key) || null;
    const v = rec ? rec.version : 0;
    const pv = this.primary.data.has(req.key) ? this.primary.data.get(req.key).version : 0;
    const stale = v < pv;
    if (stale) {
      this.metrics.staleReads++; req.stale = true;
      this.hist(req, 'warn', 'stale-read', `replica returned ${req.key}@v${v} but primary is at v${pv} — replica has not applied ${pv - v} version(s) yet`);
      this.ev('warn', 'REPLICA', `${req.id} read ${req.key}@v${v} is STALE — primary at v${pv}, replication lag ${this.cfg.replicaLag} ms`, req.id);
    } else {
      this.hist(req, 'ok', 'read', rec ? `read ${req.key}@v${v} from replica (fresh)` : `read ${req.key}: no record yet (empty result)`);
    }
    req.outcome = stale ? 'ok-read-stale' : 'ok-read';
    this.transit('replica_gw', stale ? 'stale' : 'reply-read', req.id, HOP.replica_gw, () => {
      if (rec) {
        this.cache.data.set(req.key, { value: rec.value, version: rec.version, cachedAt: this.time, expiresAt: this.time + this.cfg.cacheTTL });
        this.hist(req, 'info', 'cache-fill', `read-through: cached ${req.key}@v${rec.version} for ${this.cfg.cacheTTL} ms`);
        this.transit('gw_cache', 'cachefill', req.id, HOP.gw_cache, null);
      }
      this.transit('gw_client', stale ? 'stale' : 'reply-read', req.id, HOP.gw_client, () => this.finish(req, true));
    });
  }

  /* ---------- failure, retry, DLQ ---------- */
  failReq(req, reason, msg, atNode) {
    req.attempts++;
    req.lastError = reason;
    this.hist(req, 'err', 'failed', `attempt ${req.attempts}/${this.cfg.maxAttempts} failed: ${msg}`);
    if (reason !== 'circuit-open') {
      this.ev('err', atNode === 'replica' ? 'REPLICA' : 'PRIMARY', `${req.id} attempt ${req.attempts} failed — ${msg}`, req.id);
    }
    const toRetryNode = () => this.arriveAtRetry(req);
    if (atNode === 'primary') this.transit('primary_workers', 'fail', req.id, HOP.primary_workers, () => this.transit('workers_retry', 'fail', req.id, HOP.workers_retry, toRetryNode));
    else if (atNode === 'replica') this.transit('replica_workers', 'fail', req.id, HOP.replica_workers, () => this.transit('workers_retry', 'fail', req.id, HOP.workers_retry, toRetryNode));
    else this.transit('workers_retry', 'fail', req.id, HOP.workers_retry, toRetryNode);
  }
  arriveAtRetry(req) {
    if (req.attempts >= this.cfg.maxAttempts) {
      this.transit('retry_dlq', 'dead', req.id, HOP.retry_dlq, () => {
        req.state = 'dead';
        this.dlq.items.push({ reqId: req.id, reason: req.lastError, attempts: req.attempts, deadAt: this.time, repaired: false });
        this.metrics.deadLetters++;
        this.recordError();
        this.hist(req, 'err', 'dead-letter', `moved to dead-letter queue after ${req.attempts} attempts (last error: ${req.lastError})`);
        this.ev('err', 'DLQ', `${req.id} moved to dead-letter queue after ${req.attempts} attempts (${req.lastError})`, req.id);
      });
      return;
    }
    const delay = this.cfg.retryBase * Math.pow(2, req.attempts - 1) * (1 + this.rng.float() * this.cfg.retryJitter);
    const dueAt = this.time + delay;
    this.retry.items.push({ reqId: req.reqId || req.id, dueAt, attempt: req.attempts, deferred: false });
    this.retry.scheduled++; this.metrics.retriesScheduled++;
    req.state = 'retry-wait'; req.nextRetryAt = dueAt;
    this.hist(req, 'warn', 'retry-scheduled', `retry #${req.attempts} scheduled for T+${fmtT(dueAt)} (exponential backoff ${Math.round(delay)} ms)`, { dueAt, delay });
    this.ev('warn', 'RETRY', `${req.id} retry #${req.attempts} scheduled for T+${fmtT(dueAt)} (backoff ${Math.round(delay)} ms)`, req.id);
  }
  retryPump() {
    if (!this.retry.items.length) return;
    this.retry.items.sort((a, b) => a.dueAt - b.dueAt);
    while (this.retry.items.length && this.retry.items[0].dueAt <= this.time) {
      if (this.queue.items.length + this.queue.reserved >= this.cfg.queueCapacity) {
        const it = this.retry.items[0];
        if (!it.deferred) {
          it.deferred = true;
          this.ev('warn', 'RETRY', `${it.reqId} due but queue is full — redelivery deferred until space frees`, it.reqId);
        }
        return;
      }
      const it = this.retry.items.shift();
      const req = this.requests.get(it.reqId);
      if (!req || req.state === 'dead') continue;
      req.isRetry = true;
      this.queue.reserved++;
      this.transit('retry_queue', 'retry', req.id, HOP.retry_queue, () => {
        this.queue.reserved--;
        this.queue.items.push(req);
        req.state = 'queued';
        this.hist(req, 'info', 'requeued', `retry attempt re-entered the work queue`);
      });
    }
  }

  /* ---------- replica ---------- */
  replicaPump() {
    const p = this.primary, r = this.replica;
    while (r.applyIndex < p.log.length) {
      const rec = p.log[r.applyIndex];
      if (rec.committedAt + this.cfg.replicaLag > this.time) break;
      r.data.set(rec.key, rec);
      r.version = rec.version;
      r.applyIndex++; r.applied++;
    }
  }

  /* ---------- circuit breaker ---------- */
  breakerAllow() {
    const b = this.breaker;
    if (b.state === 'closed') return true;
    if (b.state === 'open') {
      if (this.time - b.openedAt >= this.cfg.breakerCooldown) {
        b.state = 'half-open'; b.probeInFlight = false;

  sendRequest(opts) { return this.injectRequest(opts || {}); }
  sendBurst(n) {
    const b = ++this.burstSeq;
    this.ev('sys', 'CLIENT', `burst of ${n} requests injected`, null);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) this.schedule(i * 24, () => this.injectRequest({}));
  }
  sendDuplicateBurst() {
    const b = ++this.burstSeq;
    this.ev('sys', 'CLIENT', `duplicate burst: 10 writes sharing 5 idempotency keys — the primary must commit each key once`, null);
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const k = KEYS[(b + (i % 5)) % KEYS.length];
      this.schedule(i * 30, () => this.injectRequest({ op: 'write', key: k, idemKey: `dup-${b}-${i % 5}` }));
    }
  }

  /* ---------- transits (packets travelling between components) ---------- */
  transit(edge, kind, reqId, dur, onArrive) {
    const t = { id: ++this.transitSeq, edge, kind, reqId, start: this.time, end: this.time + dur };
    this.transits.push(t);
    this.schedule(dur, () => {
      const i = this.transits.indexOf(t);
      if (i >= 0) this.transits.splice(i, 1);
      onArrive && onArrive();
    });
  }

  /* ---------- gateway ---------- */
  gatewayAdmit(req) {
    this.gateway.arrived++;
    if (this.gateway.tokens < 1) {
      this.gateway.rejected++; this.metrics.rateLimited++;
      req.state = 'rejected'; req.outcome = 'rejected-rate-limit'; req.lastError = 'rate-limited';
      this.hist(req, 'err', 'rate-limited', 'gateway rejected: token bucket empty (429)');
      this.ev('warn', 'GATEWAY', `rate limiter rejected ${req.id} — no token available (bucket empty, refills at ${this.cfg.gatewayRate}/s)`, req.id);
      this.recordError();
      this.transit('gw_client', 'fail', req.id, HOP.gw_client, () => this.finish(req, false));
      return;
    }
    this.gateway.tokens -= 1;
    this.gateway.accepted++;
    if (req.op === 'read') {
      const e = this.cache.data.get(req.key);
      if (e && e.expiresAt > this.time) return this.serveCacheHit(req, e);
      if (e) {
        this.cache.data.delete(req.key);
        this.cache.expired++;
        this.ev('info', 'CACHE', `entry for ${req.key} expired ${this.time - e.expiresAt} ms ago — treated as a miss, not a hit`, req.id);
      }
      this.cache.misses++;
      this.hist(req, 'info', 'cache-miss', `cache miss for ${req.key} — read-through via queue and replica`);
    }
    this.enqueueViaGateway(req);
  }
  serveCacheHit(req, e) {
    this.cache.hits++;
    const pv = this.primary.data.has(req.key) ? this.primary.data.get(req.key).version : 0;
    const stale = e.version < pv;
    if (stale) {
      this.metrics.staleReads++; req.stale = true;
      this.ev('warn', 'CACHE', `${req.id} served ${req.key}@v${e.version} from cache but primary is at v${pv} — stale until invalidation or expiry`, req.id);
    }
    this.hist(req, stale ? 'warn' : 'ok', 'cache-hit', `cache hit for ${req.key}@v${e.version}${stale ? ' (STALE vs primary v' + pv + ')' : ''}`);
    this.transit('gw_cache', 'read', req.id, HOP.gw_cache, () => {
      this.transit('cache_gw', stale ? 'stale' : 'hit', req.id, HOP.cache_gw, () => {
        this.transit('gw_client', stale ? 'stale' : 'hit', req.id, HOP.gw_client, () => {
          req.outcome = stale ? 'ok-cache-stale' : 'ok-cache-hit';
          this.finish(req, true);
        });
      });
    });
  }
  enqueueViaGateway(req) {
    if (this.queue.items.length + this.queue.reserved >= this.cfg.queueCapacity) {
      this.gateway.shed++; this.metrics.shed++;
      req.state = 'rejected'; req.outcome = 'rejected-backpressure'; req.lastError = 'queue-full';
      this.hist(req, 'err', 'shed', `queue full (${this.cfg.queueCapacity}) — request shed by backpressure`);
      this.ev('err', 'GATEWAY', `${req.id} shed: work queue at capacity ${this.cfg.queueCapacity} (backpressure)`, req.id);
      this.recordError();
      this.transit('gw_client', 'fail', req.id, HOP.gw_client, () => this.finish(req, false));
      return;
    }
    this.queue.reserved++;
    this.transit('gw_queue', req.op, req.id, HOP.gw_queue, () => {
      this.queue.reserved--;
      this.queue.items.push(req);
      req.state = 'queued'; req.enqueuedAt = this.time;
      this.hist(req, 'info', 'queued', `enqueued at depth ${this.queue.items.length}/${this.cfg.queueCapacity}`);
    });
  }

  /* ---------- workers ---------- */
  workerPump() {
    for (const w of this.workers) {
      if (!w.enabled || w.stopped || w.phase !== 'idle') continue;
      if (!this.queue.items.length) break;
      const req = this.queue.items.shift();
      w.phase = 'busy'; w.req = req; w.busyStart = this.time; w.busyUntil = this.time; // set for real at service start
      const token = ++w.jobToken;
      req.state = 'dispatched'; req.workerId = w.id;
      this.transit('queue_workers', req.isRetry ? 'retry' : req.op, req.id, HOP.queue_workers, () => {
        if (w.jobToken !== token || w.stopped) return; // worker was stopped mid-dispatch; request already requeued
        const st = Math.max(40, this.cfg.serviceMean + (this.rng.float() * 2 - 1) * this.cfg.serviceJitter);
        w.busyStart = this.time; w.busyUntil = this.time + st;
        req.state = 'processing';
        this.hist(req, 'info', 'processing', `worker W${w.id} processing (service ${Math.round(st)} ms, attempt ${req.attempts + 1}/${this.cfg.maxAttempts})`);
        this.schedule(st, () => {
          if (w.jobToken !== token || w.stopped) return;
          w.phase = 'idle'; w.req = null;
          this.executeOp(req, w);
        });
      });
    }
  }
  executeOp(req, w) {
    if (req.op === 'write') {
      if (!this.breakerAllow()) {
        this.ev('warn', 'BREAKER', `${req.id} failed fast — circuit is ${this.breaker.state.toUpperCase()}, primary not contacted`, req.id);
        return this.failReq(req, 'circuit-open', 'circuit breaker open — failed fast without contacting primary', 'workers');
      }
      this.transit('workers_primary', req.isRetry ? 'retry' : 'write', req.id, HOP.workers_primary, () => this.commitAtPrimary(req));
    } else {
      this.transit('workers_replica', req.isRetry ? 'retry' : 'read', req.id, HOP.workers_replica, () => this.readAtReplica(req));
    }
  }
  commitAtPrimary(req) {
    const p = this.primary;
    if (!p.up) {
      this.breakerFail();
      return this.failReq(req, 'primary-down', 'primary database unavailable — commit refused', 'primary');
    }
    if (req.poison) {
      this.breakerSuccess(); // the database answered; the payload itself is bad
      return this.failReq(req, 'poison', 'primary rejected malformed payload (poison message)', 'primary');
    }
    if (this.rng.chance(this.cfg.writeFailRate)) {
      this.breakerFail();
      return this.failReq(req, 'transient', 'transient commit error (lock timeout)', 'primary');
    }
    this.breakerSuccess();
    if (p.committedKeys.has(req.idemKey)) {
      const v = p.committedKeys.get(req.idemKey);
      this.metrics.duplicatesPrevented++;
      req.outcome = 'ok-dedup';
      this.hist(req, 'ok', 'dedup', `write skipped — idempotency key "${req.idemKey}" already committed as v${v}; duplicate prevented`);
      this.ev('ok', 'PRIMARY', `${req.id} write skipped: idempotency key "${req.idemKey}" already committed (v${v}) — duplicate prevented`, req.id);
      return this.replyFromPrimary(req, false);
    }
    p.seq++;
    const rec = { key: req.key, value: `${req.key} = v${p.seq}`, version: p.seq, idemKey: req.idemKey, writerId: req.id, committedAt: this.time };
    p.data.set(req.key, rec);
    p.log.push(rec);
    p.committedKeys.set(req.idemKey, p.seq);
    p.commits++;
    req.outcome = 'ok-write';
    this.hist(req, 'ok', 'committed', `committed ${req.key}@v${p.seq} durably on the primary`);
    this.ev('ok', 'PRIMARY', `${req.id} committed ${req.key}@v${p.seq}${req.isRetry ? ' (after retry)' : ''}`, req.id);
    this.replyFromPrimary(req, true);
  }
  replyFromPrimary(req, committed) {
    this.transit('primary_gw', 'reply-write', req.id, HOP.primary_gw, () => {
      if (committed) {
        const had = this.cache.data.has(req.key);
        if (had) {
          this.cache.data.delete(req.key);
          this.cache.invalidations++;
          this.ev('info', 'CACHE', `key ${req.key} invalidated after write ${req.id}`, req.id);
          this.transit('gw_cache', 'invalidate', req.id, HOP.gw_cache, null);
        }
      }
      this.transit('gw_client', 'reply-write', req.id, HOP.gw_client, () => this.finish(req, true));
    });
  }
  readAtReplica(req) {
    if (this.rng.chance(this.cfg.readFailRate)) {
      return this.failReq(req, 'transient-read', 'transient replica read error', 'replica');
    }
    const rec = this.replica.data.get(req.key) || null;
    const v = rec ? rec.version : 0;
    const pv = this.primary.data.has(req.key) ? this.primary.data.get(req.key).version : 0;
    const stale = v < pv;
    if (stale) {
      this.metrics.staleReads++; req.stale = true;
      this.hist(req, 'warn', 'stale-read', `replica returned ${req.key}@v${v} but primary is at v${pv} — replica has not applied ${pv - v} version(s) yet`);
      this.ev('warn', 'REPLICA', `${req.id} read ${req.key}@v${v} is STALE — primary at v${pv}, replication lag ${this.cfg.replicaLag} ms`, req.id);
    } else {
      this.hist(req, 'ok', 'read', rec ? `read ${req.key}@v${v} from replica (fresh)` : `read ${req.key}: no record yet (empty result)`);
    }
    req.outcome = stale ? 'ok-read-stale' : 'ok-read';
    this.transit('replica_gw', stale ? 'stale' : 'reply-read', req.id, HOP.replica_gw, () => {
      if (rec) {
        this.cache.data.set(req.key, { value: rec.value, version: rec.version, cachedAt: this.time, expiresAt: this.time + this.cfg.cacheTTL });
        this.hist(req, 'info', 'cache-fill', `read-through: cached ${req.key}@v${rec.version} for ${this.cfg.cacheTTL} ms`);
        this.transit('gw_cache', 'cachefill', req.id, HOP.gw_cache, null);
      }
      this.transit('gw_client', stale ? 'stale' : 'reply-read', req.id, HOP.gw_client, () => this.finish(req, true));
    });
  }

  /* ---------- failure, retry, DLQ ---------- */
  failReq(req, reason, msg, atNode) {
    req.attempts++;
    req.lastError = reason;
    this.hist(req, 'err', 'failed', `attempt ${req.attempts}/${this.cfg.maxAttempts} failed: ${msg}`);
    if (reason !== 'circuit-open') {
      this.ev('err', atNode === 'replica' ? 'REPLICA' : 'PRIMARY', `${req.id} attempt ${req.attempts} failed — ${msg}`, req.id);
    }
    const toRetryNode = () => this.arriveAtRetry(req);
    if (atNode === 'primary') this.transit('primary_workers', 'fail', req.id, HOP.primary_workers, () => this.transit('workers_retry', 'fail', req.id, HOP.workers_retry, toRetryNode));
    else if (atNode === 'replica') this.transit('replica_workers', 'fail', req.id, HOP.replica_workers, () => this.transit('workers_retry', 'fail', req.id, HOP.workers_retry, toRetryNode));
    else this.transit('workers_retry', 'fail', req.id, HOP.workers_retry, toRetryNode);
  }
  arriveAtRetry(req) {
    if (req.attempts >= this.cfg.maxAttempts) {
      this.transit('retry_dlq', 'dead', req.id, HOP.retry_dlq, () => {
        req.state = 'dead';
        this.dlq.items.push({ reqId: req.id, reason: req.lastError, attempts: req.attempts, deadAt: this.time, repaired: false });
        this.metrics.deadLetters++;
        this.recordError();
        this.hist(req, 'err', 'dead-letter', `moved to dead-letter queue after ${req.attempts} attempts (last error: ${req.lastError})`);
        this.ev('err', 'DLQ', `${req.id} moved to dead-letter queue after ${req.attempts} attempts (${req.lastError})`, req.id);
      });
      return;
    }
    const delay = this.cfg.retryBase * Math.pow(2, req.attempts - 1) * (1 + this.rng.float() * this.cfg.retryJitter);
    const dueAt = this.time + delay;
    this.retry.items.push({ reqId: req.reqId || req.id, dueAt, attempt: req.attempts, deferred: false });
    this.retry.scheduled++; this.metrics.retriesScheduled++;
    req.state = 'retry-wait'; req.nextRetryAt = dueAt;
    this.hist(req, 'warn', 'retry-scheduled', `retry #${req.attempts} scheduled for T+${fmtT(dueAt)} (exponential backoff ${Math.round(delay)} ms)`, { dueAt, delay });
    this.ev('warn', 'RETRY', `${req.id} retry #${req.attempts} scheduled for T+${fmtT(dueAt)} (backoff ${Math.round(delay)} ms)`, req.id);
  }
  retryPump() {
    if (!this.retry.items.length) return;
    this.retry.items.sort((a, b) => a.dueAt - b.dueAt);
    while (this.retry.items.length && this.retry.items[0].dueAt <= this.time) {
      if (this.queue.items.length + this.queue.reserved >= this.cfg.queueCapacity) {
        const it = this.retry.items[0];
        if (!it.deferred) {
          it.deferred = true;
          this.ev('warn', 'RETRY', `${it.reqId} due but queue is full — redelivery deferred until space frees`, it.reqId);
        }
        return;
      }
      const it = this.retry.items.shift();
      const req = this.requests.get(it.reqId);
      if (!req || req.state === 'dead') continue;
      req.isRetry = true;
      this.queue.reserved++;
      this.transit('retry_queue', 'retry', req.id, HOP.retry_queue, () => {
        this.queue.reserved--;
        this.queue.items.push(req);
        req.state = 'queued';
        this.hist(req, 'info', 'requeued', `retry attempt re-entered the work queue`);
      });
    }
  }

  /* ---------- replica ---------- */
  replicaPump() {
    const p = this.primary, r = this.replica;
    while (r.applyIndex < p.log.length) {
      const rec = p.log[r.applyIndex];
      if (rec.committedAt + this.cfg.replicaLag > this.time) break;
      r.data.set(rec.key, rec);
      r.version = rec.version;
      r.applyIndex++; r.applied++;
    }
  }

  /* ---------- circuit breaker ---------- */
  breakerAllow() {
    const b = this.breaker;
    if (b.state === 'closed') return true;
    if (b.state === 'open') {
      if (this.time - b.openedAt >= this.cfg.breakerCooldown) {
        b.state = 'half-open'; b.probeInFlight = false;
        this.ev('warn', 'BREAKER', `cooldown elapsed (${this.cfg.breakerCooldown} ms) — circuit HALF-OPEN, admitting a single probe`, null);
      } else return false;
    }
    if (b.state === 'half-open') {
      if (!b.probeInFlight) { b.probeInFlight = true; return true; }
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  breakerFail() {
    const b = this.breaker;
    if (b.state === 'half-open') {
      b.state = 'open'; b.openedAt = this.time; b.probeInFlight = false; b.opens++;
      this.ev('err', 'BREAKER', 'probe failed — circuit re-OPENED for another cooldown', null);
      return;
    }
    b.failures++;
    if (b.state === 'closed' && b.failures >= this.cfg.breakerThreshold) {
      b.state = 'open'; b.openedAt = this.time; b.opens++;
      this.ev('err', 'BREAKER', `circuit OPENED after ${b.failures} consecutive commit failures — writes now fail fast for ${this.cfg.breakerCooldown} ms`, null);
    }
  }
  breakerSuccess() {
    const b = this.breaker;
    if (b.state === 'half-open') {
      b.state = 'closed'; b.failures = 0; b.probeInFlight = false;
      this.ev('ok', 'BREAKER', 'probe succeeded — circuit CLOSED, writes flow to the primary again', null);
    } else b.failures = 0;
  }

  /* ---------- completion & metrics ---------- */
  finish(req, ok) {
    req.state = ok ? 'done' : 'rejected';
    req.completedAt = this.time;
    req.latency = this.time - req.createdAt;
    if (ok) {
      this.metrics.completed++;
      this.metrics.completions.push({ t: this.time, latency: req.latency });
      this.hist(req, 'ok', 'completed', `response delivered to client — ${req.outcome}, end-to-end ${req.latency} ms`);
    } else {
      this.hist(req, 'err', 'closed', `client received failure (${req.outcome}) after ${req.latency} ms`);
    }
  }
  recordError() { this.metrics.errorsTotal++; this.metrics.errors.push({ t: this.time }); }
  sampleMetrics() {
    const m = this.metrics, now = this.time;
    while (m.completions.length && m.completions[0].t < now - 6000) m.completions.shift();
    while (m.errors.length && m.errors[0].t < now - 6000) m.errors.shift();
    const okWin = m.completions.filter(c => c.t > now - 2500).length;
    const tput = okWin / 2.5;
    const lats = m.completions.filter(c => c.t > now - 5000).map(c => c.latency).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const p95 = lats.length ? lats[Math.min(lats.length - 1, Math.floor(lats.length * 0.95))] : 0;
    const errWin = m.errors.filter(e => e.t > now - 3000).length;
    const okWin3 = m.completions.filter(c => c.t > now - 3000).length;
    const err = pct(errWin, errWin + okWin3);
    const s = m.samples;
    s.t.push(now); s.tput.push(tput); s.p95.push(p95); s.err.push(err); s.depth.push(this.queue.items.length);
    const cap = 240;
    if (s.t.length > cap) { s.t.shift(); s.tput.shift(); s.p95.shift(); s.err.shift(); s.depth.shift(); }
    m.last = { tput, p95, err, depth: this.queue.items.length };
  }

  /* ---------- operator actions ---------- */
  setTraffic(v, who) { const old = this.cfg.trafficRate; this.cfg.trafficRate = v; if (v !== old) this.ev('sys', who || 'CONTROL', `traffic rate set to ${v} req/s`, null); }
  setWorkers(n, who) {
    n = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, n | 0));
    if (n === this.cfg.workerCount) return;
    this.cfg.workerCount = n;
    this.workers.forEach((w, i) => { w.enabled = i < n; });
    this.ev('sys', who || 'CONTROL', `worker pool set to ${n} worker(s)`, null);
  }
  setGatewayRate(v, who) { this.cfg.gatewayRate = v; this.ev('sys', who || 'CONTROL', `gateway rate limit set to ${v} tokens/s`, null); }
  setServiceTime(v, who) { this.cfg.serviceMean = v; this.ev('sys', who || 'CONTROL', `mean service time set to ${v} ms`, null); }
  failPrimary(who) {
    if (!this.primary.up) return;
    this.primary.up = false;
    this.ev('err', 'PRIMARY', `primary database FAILED (${who || 'operator'}) — commits will be refused; no fabricated successes`, null);
  }
  recoverPrimary(who) {
    if (this.primary.up) return;
    this.primary.up = true;
    this.ev('ok', 'PRIMARY', `primary database RECOVERED (${who || 'operator'}) — circuit must probe before writes flow again`, null);
  }
  togglePrimary(who) { this.primary.up ? this.failPrimary(who) : this.recoverPrimary(who); }
  stopWorker(who) {
    for (let i = this.workers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const w = this.workers[i];
      if (w.enabled && !w.stopped) {
        w.stopped = true; w.jobToken++;
        if (w.req) {
          const req = w.req;
          w.req = null; w.phase = 'idle';
          req.redeliveries++;
          req.state = 'queued';
          this.queue.items.unshift(req);
          this.hist(req, 'warn', 'redelivered', `worker W${w.id} stopped mid-flight — unacknowledged work redelivered to the queue head (no committed work lost)`);
          this.ev('warn', 'WORKER', `W${w.id} stopped — in-flight ${req.id} redelivered to queue; durable commits are unaffected`, req.id);
        } else {
          this.ev('warn', 'WORKER', `W${w.id} stopped (${who || 'operator'})`, null);
        }
        w.phase = 'idle';
        return w.id;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }
  restoreWorker(who) {
    for (const w of this.workers) {
      if (w.stopped) {
        w.stopped = false;
        this.ev('ok', 'WORKER', `W${w.id} restored to service (${who || 'operator'})`, null);
        return w.id;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }
  setReplicaLag(ms, who) {
    this.cfg.replicaLag = ms;
    this.ev(ms > 1500 ? 'warn' : 'sys', 'REPLICA', `replication lag set to ${ms} ms (${who || 'operator'})`, null);
  }
  repairDeadLetter(reqId) {
    const it = this.dlq.items.find(d => d.reqId === reqId);
    const req = this.requests.get(reqId);
    if (!it || !req) return false;
    it.repaired = true;
    if (req.poison) {
      req.poison = false;
      this.hist(req, 'ok', 'repaired', 'poison payload repaired by operator — request is now committable');
      this.ev('ok', 'DLQ', `${reqId} repaired: poison payload replaced with a valid one`, reqId);
    } else {
      this.ev('ok', 'DLQ', `${reqId} marked repaired`, reqId);
    }
    return true;
  }
  replayDeadLetter(reqId) {
    const idx = this.dlq.items.findIndex(d => d.reqId === reqId);
    const req = this.requests.get(reqId);
    if (idx < 0 || !req) return false;
    this.dlq.items.splice(idx, 1);
    this.dlq.replayed++;
    req.attempts = 0; req.isRetry = true; req.lastError = null; req.state = 'replaying';
    this.hist(req, 'info', 'replayed', `replayed from dead-letter queue${req.poison ? ' (poison condition still present!)' : ''}`);
    this.ev('sys', 'DLQ', `${reqId} replayed from the dead-letter queue${req.poison ? ' — poison not repaired, it will fail again' : ''}`, reqId);
    this.queue.reserved++;
    this.transit('dlq_queue', 'retry', req.id, HOP.dlq_queue, () => {
      this.queue.reserved--;
      this.queue.items.push(req);
      req.state = 'queued';
    });
    return true;
  }

  /* ---------- derived state ---------- */
  systemState() {
    if (!this.primary.up) return 'failed';
    const now = this.time;
    const recentThrottle = this.metrics.errors.some(e => e.t > now - 1500) && (this.gateway.rejected + this.gateway.shed) > 0 &&
      (this.gateway.tokens < 1 || this.queue.items.length + this.queue.reserved >= this.cfg.queueCapacity);
    if (this.breaker.state !== 'closed') return 'degraded';
    if (recentThrottle) return 'throttled';
    if (this.workers.some(w => w.enabled && w.stopped)) return 'degraded';
    if (this.queue.items.length > this.cfg.queueCapacity * 0.6) return 'degraded';
    if (this.cfg.replicaLag > 2000) return 'degraded';
    if (this.metrics.last.err > 15) return 'degraded';
    return 'nominal';
  }
  cacheHitRate() { return pct(this.cache.hits, this.cache.hits + this.cache.misses); }

  snapshot() {
    const q = this.queue, m = this.metrics;
    return {
      time: this.time, seed: this.seed, scenario: this.scenario, state: this.systemState(),

  path = path || 'snapshot';

# dev-browser

Browser automation tool that controls browsers through sandboxed JavaScript scripts via CLI.
Scripts run in QuickJS WASM sandbox - not Node.js. No `require`, `fetch`, `fs`, or `process`.

## Setup

If `dev-browser` is not found:
```bash
npm install -g dev-browser
dev-browser install
```

## Core Pattern

Write small, focused scripts. Each script does ONE thing. End by logging state for next decision.

```bash
dev-browser <<'EOF'
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
await page.goto("https://example.com");
console.log(JSON.stringify({ url: page.url(), title: await page.title() }, null, 2));
EOF
```

## CLI Flags

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--headless` | Launch Chromium in headless mode |
| `--connect [URL]` | Connect to running Chrome/Chromium via CDP (auto-discover Chrome, or use a specific CDP endpoint) |
| `--browser <NAME>` | Select named browser instance (default: "default") |
| `--timeout <SECONDS>` | Max script execution time (default: 30) |

## Browser API

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `browser.getPage(name)` | Get/create named page (persists between scripts) |
| `browser.newPage()` | Create anonymous page (auto-cleanup after script) |
| `browser.listPages()` | List all tabs: `[{id, url, title, name}]` |
| `browser.closePage(name)` | Close named page |

## File I/O (restricted to `~/.dev-browser/tmp/`)

Never pass absolute paths to `saveScreenshot` or `writeFile`. If a task asks for screenshots or reports in a scratchpad/output directory, save with a relative name first, then copy the returned `~/.dev-browser/tmp/...` file to the requested path from the shell.

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `await saveScreenshot(buf, name)` | Save screenshot buffer, returns path |
| `await writeFile(name, data)` | Write file, returns path |
| `await readFile(name)` | Read file, returns content |

## Key Workflows

### Discover Unknown Page

```bash
dev-browser <<'EOF'
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
await page.goto("https://example.com");
const result = await page.snapshotForAI();
console.log(result.full);
EOF
```

Then interact based on discovered elements:
```bash
dev-browser <<'EOF'
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Continue" }).click();
const result = await page.snapshotForAI({ track: "main" });
console.log(result.full);
EOF
```

### Take Screenshot

```bash
dev-browser <<'EOF'
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const buf = await page.screenshot();
const path = await saveScreenshot(buf, "debug.png");
console.log(path);
EOF
```

### Fill Form

```bash
dev-browser <<'EOF'
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
await page.fill("#email", "user@example.com");
await page.fill("#password", "secret");
await page.click("button[type=submit]");
await page.waitForURL("**/dashboard");
console.log(JSON.stringify({ url: page.url(), title: await page.title() }, null, 2));
EOF
```

### Connect to Running Chrome

```bash
dev-browser --connect <<'EOF'
const tabs = await browser.listPages();
console.log(JSON.stringify(tabs, null, 2));
EOF
```

### Connect to Helium via CDP

Helium is Chromium-based and can be controlled by `dev-browser` when launched with remote debugging enabled. `dev-browser --connect` auto-discovery does not find Helium, so always pass the explicit CDP endpoint.

For a separate automation profile:
```bash
"/Applications/Helium.app/Contents/MacOS/Helium" \
  --remote-debugging-port=9334 \
  --user-data-dir=/tmp/helium-dev-browser-profile \
  --no-first-run \
  --no-default-browser-check
```

Then connect:
```bash
dev-browser --browser helium --connect http://127.0.0.1:9334 <<'EOF'
const tabs = await browser.listPages();
console.log(JSON.stringify(tabs, null, 2));
EOF
```

To automate the user's existing Helium session, Helium must be fully quit and relaunched with `--remote-debugging-port`; an already-running Helium instance that was started without remote debugging cannot be attached by `dev-browser`.

```bash
"/Applications/Helium.app/Contents/MacOS/Helium" --remote-debugging-port=9334
dev-browser --browser helium --connect http://127.0.0.1:9334
```

If Helium is already open without CDP and must not be restarted, use AppleScript or Computer Use for UI-level control instead of `dev-browser`.

### Error Recovery

If a script fails, the page stays where it stopped. Reconnect and inspect:
```bash
dev-browser <<'EOF'
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const path = await saveScreenshot(await page.screenshot(), "debug.png");
console.log(JSON.stringify({ screenshot: path, url: page.url(), title: await page.title() }, null, 2));
EOF
```

## Tips

- Use `page.snapshotForAI()` for structure discovery; use screenshots for visual layout
- Keep page names stable across scripts to resume after failures
- Use `console.log(JSON.stringify(...))` for structured output
- Use `--timeout 10` for scripts that should fail fast
- Pages from `browser.getPage("name")` persist between script runs - no need to re-navigate
- Inside `page.evaluate(...)`, use plain JavaScript only - no TypeScript

## Full API Reference

For complete Playwright Page methods and advanced patterns, see [references/api-reference.md](references/api-reference.md).
